verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a documented model lifecycle page, where models move through defined stages from release to retirement so developers can plan migrations. It also shows per-release model cards. Together these give some trackable record of model changes, but nothing in the pack documents an actual changelog or release-notes feed. missing for 10: an explicit maintained changelog/release-notes page, coverage of API (not just model) changes, a subscribable feed or update cadence, and independent corroboration that changes are reliably announced.
